description: Header file declaring the AdbIOCompletion class, which encapsulates a wrapper around the Windows OVERLAPPED structure for asynchronous I/O operations in the Android ADB USB API.

classes.name: AdbIOCompletion
classes.description: An abstract class that manages asynchronous I/O completion using Windows OVERLAPPED structure, associated with a parent I/O object.

methods.name: AdbIOCompletion
methods.description: Constructor initializing the I/O completion object with parent I/O object, expected transfer size, and optional event handle.

methods.name: GetOvelappedIoResult
methods.description: Pure virtual method to retrieve the result of an overlapped I/O operation.

methods.name: IsCompleted
methods.description: Checks if the I/O operation has completed.

methods.name: overlapped
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the OVERLAPPED structure used for the I/O operation.

methods.name: parent_io_object
methods.description: Returns the parent I/O object associated with this completion object.

methods.name: GetParentObjectHandle
methods.description: Returns the handle of the parent I/O object.
